title: Bibi Shahrbanu Shrine

buildingCutout.basis: The named twelve-point shrine outline replaces the corresponding generic mass on the mountainside.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain just below the photographed main six-bay terrace.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Bibi Shahrbanu Shrine perimeter with the surveyed drum and dome.
mapIdentity.scope: Named OSM way 443980226 sets the stepped enclosing line, 1297335679 identifies the masonry drum, and 1297335680 fixes the position and diameter of its dome.

note: The heritage study for Rayy records a roughly 33 by 22 m historic shrine enclosure in the rock and stout southern masonry domes. The exact Qualla original shows six arched windows, a geometrically pierced parapet and the near stone retaining wall. The mapped dome sits on the southern end behind the longest facade.
